ctaText: Plan Your Overseas Golf Trip from Australia with AGS

faqs.q: What is the best golf destination for Australian golfers?
faqs.a: Vietnam (Da Nang), Thailand (Hua Hin, Phuket), and Cambodia (Siem Reap) are the three best-value, highest-quality golf destinations accessible from Australia. Vietnam has the strongest individual course quality at the top tier; Thailand offers the most variety; Cambodia pairs Angkor Wat with championship golf. Most AGS clients start with Vietnam.

faqs.q: How long is the flight from Australia to Vietnam for golf?
faqs.a: Flight times from major Australian capitals to Da Nang International Airport via Singapore or Bangkok range from 9.5 hours (Sydney) to 12 hours (Perth). Da Nang can also be reached via Ho Chi Minh City with a domestic connection. AGS can advise on optimal routing based on your departure city.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year for Australians to take a golf holiday in Southeast Asia?
faqs.a: March through May and October through January are the best windows for Australian golfers, aligning with Da Nang's dry season and Thailand's peak conditions respectively. For Australian school holiday periods, July–September works well for Da Nang (still in dry season), though book early as AGS itineraries sell out for these windows.

faqs.q: Do Australian golfers need a visa for Vietnam, Thailand, or Cambodia?
faqs.a: Australian passport holders can enter Vietnam visa-free for up to 45 days, Thailand visa-free for 30 days (extendable), and Cambodia requires an e-visa (available online, USD $30, 30-day single entry). AGS provides a pre-departure briefing covering all entry requirements for your specific nationalities.

faqs.q: Is Asia Golf Specialists based in Australia?
faqs.a: Asia Golf Specialists is a specialist luxury golf tour operator based in Southeast Asia with an Australian client focus. Our expertise is in the destination — we live and operate in Vietnam, Thailand, and Cambodia, which gives our clients access to on-ground knowledge, relationships, and flexibility that standard Australian travel agencies cannot provide.

Executive Summary:

  • Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia) offers Australian golfers a cost-effective, high-quality alternative to Japan or the UK, with estimated round costs ranging from AUD $120–260 compared to Japan's AUD $250–450 and Scotland's AUD $350–700. Flight times from Sydney are competitive, with Vietnam (Da Nang) at ~10.5 hrs and Thailand (Hua Hin/Phuket) at ~9 hrs.
  • Optimal travel windows for Australian golfers to Southeast Asia are highly seasonal and align with Australian holidays: February–May is ideal for Da Nang, while October–February suits Thailand. Specifically, the Easter long weekend (March–April) is peak season for Da Nang, and Christmas/New Year offers excellent conditions for Thailand and Cambodia.
  • Key destinations include Da Nang (Vietnam), Hua Hin/Phuket (Thailand), and Siem Reap (Cambodia), all boasting 4-5 star course quality. For example, Da Nang offers 5-star courses at AUD $170–240 per round, while Siem Reap provides 4-star experiences for AUD $120–190 per round.

Timing: Aligning with Australian Life

The optimal timing for a Southeast Asia golf trip depends on your Australian life constraints. Retirees and self-employed golfers have maximum flexibility — February through May is ideal for Da Nang, October through February for Thailand. Professionals working around Australian public holidays and school calendars have other considerations:

  • Easter long weekend extension: March–April, ideal for Da Nang (peak season)
  • EOFY June school holidays: June–July, still good for Da Nang (dry), excellent for Thailand
  • September–October: Shoulder season for both — good conditions, course availability
  • Christmas / New Year: Excellent for Thailand (peak dry season) and Cambodia

Visa Requirements for Australians

  • Vietnam: Visa-free for Australian passport holders up to 45 days (as of 2024). No application required at border. AGS confirms current entry requirements at time of booking.
  • Thailand: Visa-free for up to 30 days (extendable at the border). Passport validity of 6 months required.
  • Cambodia: E-visa required (USD $30 online application, available at evisa.gov.kh). Available on arrival also — AGS recommends e-visa to avoid arrival queues.
